_comment: The one list of lessons (WORK HARD) and games (PLAY HARD). The hub page, core/wallet.js and the server's gold API all read it. gold = reward for a fresh lesson at a perfect score; price = gold per round of a game. See CLAUDE.md 'Gold'.

work.subtitle: Week 6 · Chinese dictation 第六周 听写五

lessons.name: Tone Ride
lessons.blurb: Listen and pick which way the tone goes: flat, up, down-and-up or down.

lessons.name: Listen & Pick
lessons.blurb: Hear a word from this week's sheet and tap the right pinyin.

lessons.name: Dictation Practice
lessons.blurb: Write what you hear, tones and all, just like the real 听写 test.

work.subtitle: Write the answer right to left, one digit at a time

lessons.name: Easy Column Adding
lessons.blurb: Two-digit sums with no carrying. Start with the ones, then the tens, with help on every digit.

lessons.name: Carry the 1
lessons.blurb: When the ones make 10 or more: write one digit, carry the little 1 to the tens.

lessons.name: Hundreds Tower
lessons.blurb: Three-digit numbers in columns: ones, tens, hundreds.

lessons.name: Column Take-Away
lessons.blurb: Subtract right to left. Top digit too small? Borrow 10 from its neighbour!

lessons.name: What Kind of Word?
lessons.blurb: One word is highlighted in a sentence: is it a noun, a verb, an adjective or an adverb?

lessons.name: Tap It!
lessons.blurb: Tap every verb in the sentence. Then every noun, every adjective, every adverb…

lessons.name: Fill the Gap
lessons.blurb: A word is missing. Pick the one of the right kind to finish the sentence.

lessons.name: Word Sort Speed Round
lessons.blurb: Sixteen words, four kinds. Sort them fast for a lightning combo!

work.subtitle: French vowels and vowel teams: hear them, find them, say them!

lessons.name: Les voyelles
lessons.blurb: a, e, é, è, i, o, u: hear a sound or a word and find the missing vowel.

lessons.name: Vowel Teams
lessons.blurb: ou, oi, au, eau, ai, eu, on, an, en, in, ain: which team fills the gap in loup, roi, bateau…?

lessons.name: Say It! Pronunciation Test
lessons.blurb: Listen, then say each French word into the microphone. No mic? A listening test instead.

work.subtitle: Quick wins: numbers, time, words and 汉字

lessons.name: Make 10
lessons.blurb: Fill the ten frame! How many more to make 10, then 20?

lessons.name: Add & Subtract to 20
lessons.blurb: Quick sums up to 20. Answer fast for a lightning combo!

lessons.name: Tens & Ones
lessons.blurb: Count rods of ten and little cubes, and find 10 more or 10 less.

lessons.name: Tell the Time
lessons.blurb: Read the clock: o'clock, half past, quarter past and to, then every 5 minutes.

lessons.name: What Comes Next?
lessons.blurb: Count by 2s, 5s and 10s, finish the emoji pattern, spot the bigger number.

lessons.name: Sight Word Spell
lessons.blurb: Hear a tricky word (said, they, because…) in a sentence and spell it with tiles.

lessons.name: Hanzi Heroes
lessons.blurb: 一 to 十 and first characters like 人 口 山 水 火: see, hear and match them.

work.subtitle: Always open: keep those skills sharp

lessons.name: Add & Subtract
lessons.blurb: Three-digit numbers, with carrying and borrowing.

lessons.name: Times Tables
lessons.blurb: From 2 × 2 to 10 × 10. Answer fast for a combo!

lessons.name: Division Facts
lessons.blurb: Share things out equally: the times tables backwards.

lessons.name: Word Problems
lessons.blurb: Read the story, find the numbers, solve it.

play.name: GEM POP
play.blurb: Swap gems to line up 3 or more. Make line blasters, bombs and spinning rainbows, chain combos and get 3 stars in 25 moves!

play.name: SLICE STORM
play.blurb: Fruit flies up: swipe to slice it in half! Cut 3 at once for a combo, grab ice and frenzy stars, and NEVER slice a bomb.

play.name: SKY HOP
play.blurb: Froggy bounces by itself, you steer! Hop up through the sky on springs and jetpacks, dodge crumbly platforms and stomp monsters.

play.name: SWARM
play.blurb: Monsters everywhere! Your weapons fire by themselves: just move, grab gems, level up and pick new powers. Survive 5 minutes and beat two bosses.

play.name: MERGE MOON
play.blurb: Drop space rocks in the jar. Two the same squish into a bigger one: moons, planets, suns… Don't let the jar overflow!

play.name: CROWD RUSH
play.blurb: Steer your runners through the best math gate: +10 or ×2? Grow a huge crowd, smash the red team and beat the giant!

play.name: BLOCK BOOM
play.blurb: Drag the blocks onto the board. Fill a row or a column and BOOM, it explodes! Chain clears for giant combos.

play.name: WIGGLE.IO
play.blurb: Be the biggest snake in the neon arena! Eat glowing dots, boost to cut off rivals and gobble what they leave behind.

play.name: CASTLE
play.blurb: Build farms, walls and towers around your castle, then hold off an endless army. A boss shows up every two minutes!

play.name: ALIEN IN SPACE
play.blurb: Aliens pop out from behind the rocks and drop from the sky. Aim, pick the right space gun and survive wave after wave.

play.name: HOOK
play.blurb: Hold to grab a glowing dot, let go to fly! Swing over lasers through 10 levels to reach the exit portal.

play.name: KART
play.blurb: Pick one of 8 drivers and race 7 rivals for 3 laps on sunny, candy, cloud and volcano tracks.

play.name: SUPER BAKING
play.blurb: Customers are lining up! Crack eggs, whisk, roll and decorate in quick mini-games before time runs out.

play.name: FOOT
play.blurb: Wacky 4 vs 4 football! Tap to pass, hold for a flaming super shot, dash to tackle. Watch out for giant mushrooms and cows.
